Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from the Q&A: teams want a single short answer about credits vs quotas vs burst buffers during launches. Can we have a tiny playbook?

Samir (VP Product): Short answers: 1) Credits = monetary only, do not change rate limits. 2) Quotas/reserved capacity = throughput & SLA. 3) Burst buffer = short token-bucket for small spikes. For anything beyond burst, open a Launch Support request.

Jamie (Finance): Add: invoice credits vs platform credits. Platform credits lower invoice balance; invoice credits are special and must go through Sales/Finance. Neither alters quotas unless product approves a quota change.

Riley (Support): Triage checklist to include in the playbook: account ID, start/end (tz), peak RPS, endpoints, SDK, sample request, fallback plan. Use the console "Launch Support" form so it routes correctly.

Maya (PM): Action: I'll publish a one-line console FAQ + a one-page Launch Playbook (checklist, link to form, billing note). ETA: Wed. Samir will add gating rules for auto-approve thresholds.

Samir (VP Product): Gating preview: auto-approve if <= 30% above base QPS for <= 10 minutes and risk_score < 45. Manual review otherwise. We'll formalize in docs.

Ava (CEO): Perfect. Keep it short and put the link in the all-hands notes. Closing thread unless objections. :rocket:
